newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 3.228 billion yuan from 3.859 billion last Friday, with the seven-day contract the most active.
Trader said the rates were capped by official comments that China's interest rates should be cut but trading remained active because Monday was first quarter 1997 settlement day for state banks.
The China Daily on Monday quoted an unidentified senior official of the central bank as saying China should cut interest rates again to curb inflation.

Traders said it indicated the central bank thought current interbank rates and the treasury repo rates were too high and should be adjusted by monetary policy this year, which would add some pressure to the market in the mid-term.
